label: Hire a room
description: The rooms for hire, then the contact form.

settings.text: For parties, classes, meetings and supper clubs, by the hour. Community groups pay half.

settings.name: Main hall
settings.text: Seats 80, or 120 standing. A stage, a piano and a hearing loop. Parties, classes and meetings.

settings.name: Small room
settings.text: Sixteen round one table, with a screen and a whiteboard. Meetings and workshops.

settings.name: Kitchen
settings.text: A six-ring cooker, two ovens and a dishwasher. For caterers and supper clubs, with the hall or alone.

settings.heading: Ask about a booking
settings.text: Tell us the day, the time and roughly how many. We reply within two working days.
